trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other trophies to unlock this platinum trophy. This is the final trophy in the game that completes your journey through Vice City and Leonida.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission called 'Gone Fishing'. This is your first introduction to the game mechanics and storyline.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the main story campaign. This chapter introduces you to the basics of the game world and your character's role.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the main story. This chapter expands on your character's involvement with the criminal underworld.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the main story campaign. This chapter typically involves major plot developments and new locations.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the main story. This chapter usually leads toward the climax of the central storyline.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the main story campaign. This concludes the primary storyline of the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. This early mission helps establish your character's relationships and responsibilities.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the The Cartel Heist mission. This typically involves planning and executing a significant heist operation.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. This mission often deals with family dynamics and relationships in the game world.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the Headliners mission. This typically involves entertainment industry elements and celebrity interactions.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. This mission usually involves government agencies and counter-intelligence operations.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the Operation Savage Glory mission. This typically involves large-scale military or tactical operations.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion of the main story and all collectibles. This gold trophy requires extensive exploration and mission completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts throughout the game world. Stunts can be performed on vehicles, motorcycles, or while on foot. They are often found in designated stunt locations.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 different activity types at least once. These include activities like fishing, racing, flying, and other recreational pursuits.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete all 42 Shooting Range challenges with gold medals. These challenges are typically located in designated shooting ranges around the map.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. These races are typically held in various parts of the city with different layouts.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. These can be various types of races including street races, circuit races, and other competitive events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge. This is typically an early activity that introduces players to fishing mechanics.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. These are typically found in various locations throughout the city and offer different gameplay experiences.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. These side missions typically involve supporting characters and provide additional story content.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. These side missions often focus on specific character relationships and personal storylines.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. These side missions help expand the game's world and character development.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands. These missions typically involve helping random characters in the world and completing their quests for rewards.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. These side missions provide additional narrative content and character development.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. These side missions often involve unique characters and interesting storylines.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots. These meditation spots are scattered throughout the map and provide peaceful moments in the game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. This collectible involves finding and hunting a specific animal that's unique to the game world.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. These cards are typically found throughout the game world and require collecting specific cards to complete sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. This collectible involves performing a specific action at 100 different locations throughout the game world.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. These challenges are typically found throughout the game world and offer varied objectives to complete.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. This requires coordinating with a partner to get into and out of a high wanted situation.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level. This requires careful coordination and timing with a partner.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. These vehicles are scattered throughout the game world and can be found in various locations.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. This requires precise timing and positioning to hit multiple targets with a single use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way. This typically involves finding alternative exit routes or methods of leaving the facility.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). This involves fighting or dealing with Rhino tanks in the game world.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. This requires stealth and careful planning to avoid detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. This requires planning and executing multiple heists with careful attention to security.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This typically involves a high-risk, high-reward heist with significant security.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This requires visiting all regions of the game world to discover everything.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. This involves targeting different gang territories and operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a leisure activity that provides a relaxing moment in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style. This requires using destruction mechanics to escape from a showroom.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. This is a recreational activity that can be enjoyed for fun.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This typically involves cooperative gameplay with a partner character.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500). This trophy relates to the player's decisions throughout the game affecting outcomes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This typically refers to retrying a mission or challenge that initially failed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This refers to experiencing unusual or mysterious events in the game world.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. This involves using melee weapons while driving to take down targets.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills. This requires using various methods to clean dirty money through legitimate channels.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. This involves purchasing items from various vendors throughout the game world.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. This involves purchasing all available garage properties in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. This involves registering vehicles to the app for tracking and management.
